system.description: The phone's own Vulkan driver via the wrapper

turnip26.3.0-devel-1b51639c20.source: Mesa 26.3.0-devel 1b51639c20 Turnip; validated on the Galaxy S23 (Adreno 740) on 2026-10-03; see graphics/turnip.json

turnip-gen8-stevenmxz-v37.source: Turnip Gen8 V37 by StevenMXZ (Mesa a995eaeda4 plus the turnip/gen8 branch), 2026-09-30; knows A840 as 0x44050A21 and A830 as 0x44050001; see graphics/turnip-gen8-stevenmxz-v37.json

turnip-v32-rp6sched.source: Turnip-V32-RP6sched by arusiasotto (github.com/arusiasotto/wow-forever-a840), 2026-09-26: whitebelyash/mesa-unified turnip/gen8 9c7e022 plus the RP6 ir3 barycentric scheduler patch and vk_icd exports (Mesa 26.3.0-devel-9c7e022+rp6sched); the driver of the only reported in-world WoW run on an Adreno 840 (RedMagic 11 Pro, D3D11). Knows A840 as 0xffff44050A31 and A825 as 0x44030000. Downloaded on first use; the download and install were verified on the Galaxy S23 on 2026-10-11, where WoW renders broken in-world, so keep it to Adreno 8xx profiles.

adreno-7xx.notes: Adreno 7xx (Galaxy S23, Adreno 740): the pinned Turnip, the long-standing default.

adreno-6xx.notes: Adreno 6xx: same driver choice as before device rules existed; no 6xx phone has been tested.

adreno-8xx.notes: Adreno 800-839 (Gen 8 below the 840: 810, 825, 829, 830; Snapdragon 8 Elite, 8s Gen 4): the Adreno 840 setup (V32-RP6sched, then Gen 8 V37, with D3D11), then the pinned Turnip and the system driver. A Lenovo tablet with an Adreno 825 drew incorrectly on the pinned Turnip with D3D12 (issue #17). Not yet run on an Adreno 8xx phone.

adreno-84x.notes: Adreno 840 (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5): V32-RP6sched with D3D11, the setup of the only reported in-world WoW run on an 840, then Gen 8 V37 and the system driver. Mainline Turnip (0.0.1) and V37 (0.0.2) both drew corruption with D3D12 on a OnePlus 15 (issue #13, chip 0x44050A31, which every bundled driver knows). D3D11 renders correctly on the Galaxy S23. Not yet run on an Adreno 840 phone.

adreno-other.notes: Any other Adreno: same driver choice as before device rules existed.

mali.notes: Mali and Immortalis (Pixel 8a, Mali-G715): the system driver with the BCn compat layer.

non-adreno-other.notes: Xclipse, PowerVR and other non-Adreno GPUs: the system driver with the BCn compat layer, as before device rules existed.

unknown-gpu.notes: No GL renderer string: treated as a possible Adreno like before device rules existed.

rules.source: KGSL chip id 0x44050Axx (the OnePlus 15 and Galaxy S26 Ultra report 0x44050A31; 0x44050A21 was seen on a POCO F9 Pro); works when the renderer string has no model
GL renderer reports an Adreno 800-839 (Gen 8 below the 840)
